name: 建國科技大學綠崗亭
selected_version: 2013年上傳照片所示完整主亭外觀近似；原拍日期未獨立確認，非2026現況或測繪
method: Personally re-viewed the two original 2048-pixel complementary source photographs, then all five final 1200×1200 PNGs. Final front was viewed after the stone/finial correction, and other four only after final manifest freeze.
Read source handoff, model README/QA/SOURCES, selected design-features and current layer QA records; no private source images copied into model package.

Independently rehashed STL, colored/editable artifacts and every PNG; compared exact bytes/SHA with final render manifest and builder isolated-rebuild/reopen records. No claim that the reviewer personally reran renderer, mesh topology tests, exchange edits, slicing or physical printing.

per_view.front: PASS — complete pavilion, gray corner columns, upper/lower openings rotated 90 degrees, lower open floor and upper red rails; nonrectangular stone relief and rounded finial now present. Full geometry in frame.
per_view.rear: PASS — single external straight stair with continuous full-width underside slab; upper landing connects to the narrow gap beside upper moon panel, not through the circular window; lower eave interrupted at stair opening.
per_view.elevation: PASS — lower moon gate and open upper rail face are not stacked identical holes; two storeys remain open, rounded finial and platform relief recognizable. Fine ornamental counts simplified.
per_view.top: PASS — single four-hip upper roof, surrounding lower eave and unique stair notch; roof ribs do not project across the notch. No second stair or invented approach bridge.
per_view.left_oblique: PASS — complementary moon-window/rail face, full staircase bottom/top, notch and platform visible. Red rail and gray slab remain distinct, not a narrow stringer substituted for slab.

resolved: Regular rectangular brick facade replaced with nonrectangular polygonal stone relief; accepted as coarse micro-scale stone approximation, not individual surveyed stones.
Flat-topped cylindrical roof stump replaced by narrowed neck and enlarged rounded head, matching source finial category.
Earlier eave-rib crossing issue was already removed before first pixel review; final top/rear/oblique still show clean stair notch.

accepted_source_limits: Four corner posts and their positions are reliable; circular cross-section is an explicitly disclosed approximation, not a measured resolution of ambiguous source shading.
All lengths, roof slopes, step counts, tile/rail/frieze counts and stone pattern are approximate and reduced for micro-scale fabrication.
The main pavilion terminates at its thresholds/platform. Garden approach bridges, whole pond, fountains, landscaping and hidden underwater foundations are omitted, not claimed as fully reconstructed.
Original source roof tile/ornamental density is reduced; principal roof type, two-storey negative spaces, opening orientation, stair and notch connectivity are retained.

manufacturing_limitations.note: Final finial revision changes the slice result to 10 layers / 27 non-surviving components. Earlier 9/28 and 7/21 are not final values. Appearance PASS does not certify global 0.8 mm thickness, printer settings, unsupported printing or real-world structural safety.

authority: Private local appearance review only; no main repository edits or publication.
